summary: iter335.13 (P2 AI Recommend Budget + P3 Marketplace Themes) tested. Backend: 10/10 ASGI unit tests + 13/13 live preview-URL tests PASS, plus 37/37 iter335 regression suite still green. Maker frontend (Promote tab + wizard): Recommend button + cyan recommendation card with KPIs/rationale all work; Active marketplace themes section renders correctly with pool/remaining math. Admin themes UI could NOT be visually verified — the test admin team@craftersmarket.org lacks the 'Ads' RBAC capability, so AdsTab falls back to Analytics and PromoteThemesCard never mounts in the DOM. critical_code_review_comments: services/promote_recommend.py — clean, deterministic, LLM correctly used only for rationale with safe fallback. _maker_rates clamps CTR≤30%/CVR≤20% which is sensible.
Recommendation endpoint returns full contract {recommended_cents, low/high_cents, expected_reach/clicks/orders, basis, rationale, breakdown, goal}. UI consumes all fields.
Admin theme slug enforces ^[a-z0-9-]+$ regex (returns 422 on uppercase) — matches public URL convention, good.
Active themes endpoint correctly excludes drained pools (remaining=0) and paused/ended/scheduled statuses; verified by 3 ASGI tests.

rca of the issue: Admin Ads tab UI not testable — root cause: the AdsTab component checks capability and silently swaps in Analytics when 'ads' capability is missing on the signed-in admin. The page surfaces a toast: 'No access to Ads. Showing Analytics instead. Ask a super admin if you need that capability.' Reproduction: sign in as team@craftersmarket.org via /admin/verify?token=... then navigate to /admin/dashboard?tab=ads — Analytics renders. Mitigation: provision a super-admin account for QA OR grant 'ads' capability to the standard test admin.
